findings.message: Carried forward from round 0 and re-checked on the round-2 source. The five anti-drift `example`s in registrar entry 19 establish (section 2 declaration in its own binder form) => (the Prop abbreviation): the conservative direction for the hypothesis DlHyp, but the weak direction for the four consequents. I closed the converse by direct reading: each abbreviation body is the same Pi type as its section 2 declaration modulo binder naming only ('(hG : G.IsAcyclic) (k : N)' versus 'G.IsAcyclic -> forall k : N'), so both directions hold definitionally and no consequent is weaker than its section 2 statement. Recorded so the one-directional test is not later read as two-sided.

Defect F2 is repaired and my round-0 note on this point is now closed. THEOREM-CONTRACT.yaml conclusion.statement now carries, on the contract face: the full attribution (FLNYZ 2026 section 8 for (DL)/(EX); FRESH-LEAD lane 11 for (LB)/(R5)/(XR); seat U3 and critics C-U1-T, C-U3-T, C-U3-F, C-U1-F; rows 10-16 critic-attributed and 17-19 adjudicator-attributed; the U adjudicator for the firstDescent rfl reconciliation; no external Lean text) and all six fences, including the two that were previously only on the declaration docstring and in INFORMAL-PROOF.md section 6 -- 'no no-recovery reading' with the full non-transfer list, and '(XR) is not a uniform bound on d' with the r = 0 vacuous-hypothesis-soundness. The contract face, the declaration docstring and INFORMAL-PROOF.md section 6 now agree, and nothing in the contract asserts anything contrary to any fence.

Re-verified from the bytes against the round-2 source. All 19 registrar entry digests recompute from their own bodies. Entries 1, 2, 3 (indepCount, coeff, delta) and 10, 11, 12 (indepCount_eq_card_indepSetFinset, coeff_nat, delta_nat) are byte-identical to entries 1-6 of sources/r25/c4-forest-descent-order-bound/LeanProject/LeanProof/Main.lean (736eb9df...cfe7dfe0). Carry row 9 (U3-Extension.lean, 116b4f31...b6ba08a6) lines 16-37, 39-244, 292-297 and 299-302, and carry row 10 (C-U1-T-CriticAdvances.lean, 41dae810...1c112515a) lines 179-209, 211-218 and 220-226, all still occur verbatim; both carry files match sources/c1-stage7-sources/SOURCE-DIGESTS.json and the synthesis carry table. indepDegreeSum, e (U1's extensionCount) and firstDescent agree with SEMANTIC-CONTRACT.md section 1 (D_k the incident degree sum; e(J) = |V \ N[J]|; x(G) the least k with Delta_k < 0, by Nat.find).

Every fence of the controller's formalizer brief section 2 is honoured and none is contradicted, now on all three faces (contract conclusion.statement, terminal docstring, INFORMAL-PROOF.md section 6): the implication is the award and the four consequents stay conditional until C1-LA1; C-U3-F's instance caveat; no no-recovery reading; (XR) is not a uniform bound on d; the r = 0 truncation of 4*r - 4 is vacuous-hypothesis-sound, not arithmetic; (DL) is an average over I_k with no pointwise statement registrable; nothing asymptotic; the r25 (k+1)^2 award stays registered at its own statement. No fenced object occurs in the source: no external-slice vocabulary (icoeff, Zgen, indepPoly, vpoly, Dpoly, Epoly, degDefect, indepCard, numExtensions, sum_degOn_le, prefix_ratio, degOn, indepFinsets, mem_indepFinsets), no alpha / hyp-alpha side condition, and no acyclicity binder on the unconditional counting lemmas (double_count, e_ge_sub). Acyclicity still enters exactly once, as the argument handed to the (DL) hypothesis.

Unchanged by the repair (the comment-stripped source is byte-identical), and restated. The sole hypothesis DlHyp is satisfiable, so the implication is not vacuous. Instance exhibited: the star K_{1,3} on a 4-element carrier -- i = (1, 4, 3, 1, 0), D = (0, 6, 6, 3, 0) against 2k*i_k = (0, 8, 12, 6, 0), so (DL) holds with slack at every k, and the consequents hold there ((XR) tight at r = 2: n = 4 <= 4r - 4 = 4). Independently replayed over all 40,232 labelled forests to order 7 and every k: zero violations of (DL), (EX), (LB) or (XR). The proof uses the hypothesis essentially (hDL is consumed by forest_extension_inequality), not by ex falso.

Defect F1 (false provenance) is correctly repaired, and I verified every new claim against the source rather than accepting the report. sources/c1-stage7-sources/U1-Main.lean hashes to 8cc381f413e6b5533995a362f4f38f4930d99119e8eece9a5f1cc323a62dea0d, exactly as the repaired docstrings and INFORMAL-PROOF.md section 5.2 cite it, and it IS a capsule member (it sits in sources/c1-stage7-sources/ and is row 1 of SOURCE-DIGESTS.json), so the round-0 sentence 'row 6 ... is not a member of this capsule' was false and its replacement is true. The replacement's substantive claims also check out: U1's pos_indepCount_of_delta_neg is stated at '{V : Type v} (F : SimpleGraph V) (k : N)' with no finiteness binder (U1-Main.lean line 481), while the run's is at the [Finite X] carrier row 10's critic_lb_of_ex works in; U1's firstDescent_spec body is 'Nat.find_spec (Erdos993G1.firstDescent_exists G)' (line 531) against U1's own firstDescent (line 524) and firstDescent_exists (line 495), neither of which this run registers, so that body could not have been carried in any case. Row 6 is not on the formalizer brief R7 byte-identical carry list (rows 9, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16, 19), and the synthesis's carry condition (i) admits U1's file as statements of record only, so taking the two NAMES from row 6 and writing the BODIES in-run is the correct discipline.

I re-derived the round-2 EVIDENCE/fidelity-audit-input.json independently from THEOREM-CONTRACT.yaml, RECEIPTS/reviewer-assignment.json, RECEIPTS/kernel-verification.json, RECEIPTS/dependency-authority.json and EVIDENCE/axioms.txt by the canonical projection rule, and obtained an object identical to the delivered input (1adc8a92a1368ead88d8449cefc78deaecd99ffe563bfde01ae3a8bd38d82cb9) in every field, with the attestation slot empty. No canonical field is paraphrased or omitted; in particular the repaired conclusion.statement, with its attribution and six fences, is carried through verbatim into both the contract and binding projections. The empty `dependencies` lists remain correct (dependency-authority.json is a shared-package authority receipt with no dependencies key; the only Lean dependency is the pinned Mathlib 905b95818eb32af7874a58b427f50c1711a5e96c). Both projection fingerprints recomputed by me reproduce the controller's published round-2 values.

Disclosure by this reviewer: my round-0 attestation (superseded under EVIDENCE/superseded/round-0/, RECEIPTS/superseded/round-0/fidelity-audit.json) passed the entry-14 docstring without independently testing its capsule-membership claim against sources/c1-stage7-sources/. The independent informal proof-integrity audit caught it. The defect was a record defect only -- it never touched a statement, a binder, a proof body or an axiom -- but the miss is recorded here so the controller can weigh it: a provenance sentence asserting what is or is not a capsule member is checkable against the carry directory and should have been checked in round 0. I checked it in this round.

The terminal declaration is unchanged by the repair: `DlHyp.{u} -> ExHyp.{u} /\ LbHyp.{u} /\ R5Hyp.{u} /\ XrHyp.{u}`, exactly the form the controller's formalizer brief section 2 prescribes, occurring byte-exactly in the source followed by ' :='. The synthesis (SYNTHESIS.md '## Lean awards', C1-LA3) phrases the award as 'DlHyp -> ExHyp /\ LbHyp with LbHyp -> R5 and LbHyp -> XR'; the delivered packaging is deductively equivalent and no weaker, with the four component implications present as separate kernel-checked lemmas ex_of_dl, lb_of_ex, r5_of_lb, xr_of_lb. No silent weakening, no extra hypothesis, no dropped conjunct. Each of DlHyp, ExHyp, LbHyp, R5Hyp, XrHyp remains token-identical to its frozen SOLUTION-CONTRACT.md section 2 declaration (same binders, including the instance-implicit [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [DecidableRel G.Adj] in (DL)/(EX) and [Finite X] with Nat.card in (LB)/(R5)/(XR); same hypotheses; same conclusion; same casts).
